name: deep-context
description: Durable filesystem context routing for Codex projects and tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Keep project context durable and selectively readable.
interface.longDescription: Deep Context creates self-describing project and task context trees, deterministic indexes, safe Git worktrees, evidence-bound closure workflows, local context metrics, and evidence-backed audits.
defaultPrompt: Initialize this repository with Deep Context.
Create a scoped Deep Context task.
Show Deep Context stats for this project.
Audit this Deep Context project for drift and stale work.
